visualCharacteristics: Short full-width photo banner with black left-to-right gradient overlay, left-aligned white H1 and subheading, no CTA.
contentPattern: Background image; Title (H1), subheading paragraph, optional CTA
usage: Short full-width page-intro banner with a background photo, H1 title and one-line subheading; optional CTA.
reuseGuidance: Use at the top of landing/hub pages. For tall marketing heroes with large media or multiple CTAs, use hero instead.
